meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后，用户可以让 Claude 给机器人项目新增一个 DeltaChat 渠道：消息通过电子邮件收发，并带端到端加密。Claude 会复制适配器文件、把渠道注册进项目、安装所需依赖，并运行测试确认无误。
howto.when: 当用户要求给机器人添加 DeltaChat 渠道、通过邮件收发消息，或在 /setup 流程中需要接入该渠道时。

say.text: 给我的机器人加上 DeltaChat 渠道。
say.note: 开始执行安装：复制适配器、注册渠道并安装依赖。

say.text: 配置 DeltaChat 邮箱账号，把凭据写进 .env。
把 DeltaChat 私聊接到我的智能体。

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel to a project: messages go over email with end-to-end encryption. Copies adapter and test files, registers the channel, installs the pinned RPC package, then runs build and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a DeltaChat channel, use email for messaging, or when a /setup flow needs this channel.

say_en.text: Add a DeltaChat channel to my bot.
say_en.note: Starts install: copy adapter, register channel, install deps.

say_en.text: Set up the DeltaChat email account and put credentials in .env.
say_en.note: Requires six env vars such as DC_EMAIL and DC_PASSWORD.

say_en.text: Connect DeltaChat DMs to my agent.
say_en.note: Queries the chat ID and runs init-first-agent to wire it.
